title: Fire sprinkler piping.
officialText:
Plastic fire sprinkler piping exposed within a plenum shall be used only in wet pipe systems
and shall have a peak optical density not greater than 0.50, an average optical density not greater than 0.15, and a flame spread
of not greater than 5 feet (1524 mm) when tested in accordance with UL 1887. Piping shall be listed and labeled.
